summary: Tested backend (18/18 pytest passing, 100%) and frontend (all critical flows working) for The Afterglow senior connection app. Backend endpoints for auth, profile, members, waves, messages, conversations, gatherings all behave correctly, exclude _id and password_hash, and enforce self-action guards. Frontend welcome/login/signup/discover/gathering/messages/chat/profile/premium flows all functional end-to-end using testuser@afterglow.app. Found 1 minor UI issue on /premium: the back button's tappable Pressable is misaligned relative to its absolutely-positioned '← Back' text, causing the visible label to overlap with the AFTERGLOW PREMIUM eyebrow and making the actual hit area outside the viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: In /app/frontend/app/premium.tsx the back button uses an absolutely-positioned Text (top:0, left:spacing.lg) inside a Pressable that lives at the bottom of a flex-end column. The tappable Pressable ends up in a different location from the visible '← Back' label, and Playwright reports the Pressable is outside the viewport. Visually the 'Back' label overlaps the 'AFTERGLOW PREMIUM' eyebrow (see screenshot). Move the back button out of the absolute layout, or give the Pressable a fixed position instead of the Text.

issues: '← Back' label visually overlaps 'AFTERGLOW PREMIUM' eyebrow text at top of hero

action_items: Fix premium screen back button layout — remove absolute positioning on the Text or wrap it in a fixed-positioned Pressable so the tap target aligns with the visible label and does not overlap the eyebrow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~450 line file — acceptable size, no split needed yet.
MongoDB _id and password_hash correctly excluded from all serialized responses (verified in tests).
JWT secret has a hardcoded dev fallback in server.py (line 26); production must set JWT_SECRET env — .env already sets it, but consider failing fast if unset in prod.
All frontend screens use React Native primitives (View/Text/Pressable/TextInput) and StyleSheet.create — compliant.
All interactive elements carry testID attributes — good testability.
Deprecated packages: none detected (uses expo-image, expo-linear-gradient, expo-haptics, expo-router — all current).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; premium back button hit area misaligned)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests use existing seeded users (testuser@ and margaret@afterglow.app) and generate ephemeral signup emails prefixed with 'test_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_afterglow_api.py and runs against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). All 18 tests pass in ~2s. Frontend flows tested via Playwright at 390x844: welcome → login → discover (7 members incl. 4 seeded) → send wave (marks 'Wave sent ✓') → message chat → gathering (6 items, category filter, RSVP toggle) → messages tab (conversations populated) → profile (prefilled, save shows 'Saved ✓') → premium ($5.99 + Coming soon). Only unresolved: premium-back-button hit area.
